title: Fix transcribe silently failing on current faster-whisper-xxl (#2)
paragraphs: * Fix install.ps1 aborting on the optional --diarize probes

install.ps1 runs with $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'. On Windows PowerShell, assigning a native command's output to a variable under that preference turns an expected nonzero exit into a terminating error, even with stderr redirected to $null. deps.ps1's faster_whisper/pyannote.audio probes (only used for the optional --diarize path) follow that pattern, so install.ps1 aborted there on every fresh machine, before it could even report whether ffmpeg.exe and faster-whisper-xxl.exe were present or finish writing stubs. Reproduced on a clean Windows ARM64 VM.
deps.ps1 now sets its own 'Continue' preference so these expected probe failures don't propagate as terminating errors regardless of the caller's preference.
Added test-deps.ps1, which reproduces the abort against the old script and passes against the fix, and wired it into CI next to the existing test-install.ps1 step.
* Fix transcribe silently failing on current faster-whisper-xxl

faster-whisper-xxl's --output_format now takes one or more values (argparse nargs='+'), so it greedily swallows whatever follows it on the command line. transcribe.bat put the audio path last, after --output_format srt, so the exe read the audio path as an invalid output format and every transcription failed on both CUDA and CPU. The exe's own --help already warns about this ("dont add audio after this"). Reproduced end to end on a Windows ARM64 VM with the current Faster-Whisper-XXL r245.4 release.
Moved the audio path to be the first argument on all three faster-whisper-xxl.exe invocations (CUDA, CPU, and the CPU retry).

Added test_transcribe_bat.py, which reproduces the failure against the old script and passes against the fix. It checks this textually rather than by running the real exe, since no such binary belongs in CI per this repo's own testing rules.

title: Mac CLI: transcribe, install_mac, cross-platform transcribe hook, generate-from-image --prompt
paragraphs:
- Add POSIX transcribe (ffmpeg + faster-whisper) and deps.sh; install_mac links tools.
- Share runTranscribeForVideo: Windows uses C:\dev\tools\transcribe.bat when present, else transcribe on PATH.
- generate-from-image: --prompt/--variations/--aspect/--size non-interactive mode; open/folder use macOS open.
- video-to-markdown and video-description clipboard fixes; ghopen test harness stubs gh and clears GHOPEN_OPEN_COMMAND.
- img-upscale fast binary name on non-Windows; gitignore task-stats *_with_audio mux outputs.
- Document model tiers in transcribe README; AGENTS file tree includes tools/lib.
